title: Speed Triple 1200 RR
description: The Triumph Speed Triple 1200 RR is tailored for aggressive twisties and sharp canyon transitions, positioned in the Middleweight Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1200cc engine generating 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 230 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
